home.title: Welcome, {{name}}
home.subtitle: Alice keeps track of your TLS certificates and SSH keys.
home.serverUnreachable: The server cannot be reached right now. Try reloading the page in a minute.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.signOutFailed: Could not sign you out. Try again.
nav.setupBanner: Finish setting up: choose a recovery passphrase.
nav.setupBannerFinish: Finish setting up: open the setup wizard to confirm the last step.

ui.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
ui.networkErrorAction: Check your network connection and try again.
ui.notFoundText: The address may be mistyped, or the page was moved.
ui.usernameHelp: 2 to 64 characters: English letters (A–Z), digits, dot, underscore or hyphen. Start with a letter or digit.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.help: For your security, enter the current code from your authenticator app.

totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
totp.help: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator. Then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manual: Cannot scan the code? Type this key into the app instead:

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.help: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager or a printed copy.
recoveryCodes.saved: I saved these codes in a safe place

login.title: Sign in to Alice
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.useApp: Use the code from your app

account.title: My account
account.languageHelp: Use the language switcher at the top of the page. Your choice is saved on your account.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are different. Type the same password twice.
password.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.help: Create a new set if you used most of your codes or think someone saw them. The old codes stop working.
recovery.active: Your new recovery codes are active.

code.title: Enter the setup code
code.help: The one-time setup code was shown when Alice was installed on the server.
code.label: Setup code
code.lost: Lost the code? Someone with administrator rights on the Alice server can create a new one.

language.title: Choose your language
language.label: Language for Alice and its emails

admin.title: Create the administrator account
admin.help: This account can do everything in Alice. It always signs in with a password and a code from an authenticator app.
admin.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
admin.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password twice.

passphrase.title: Choose a recovery passphrase
passphrase.warning: This passphrase protects your backups. If you lose it, backups cannot be opened and nobody, including the vendor, can help.
passphrase.label: Recovery passphrase
passphrase.help: At least 16 characters. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this server.
passphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases are different. Type the same passphrase twice.

strength.tooShort: Too short: use at least 16 characters.

done.title: Alice is ready
done.help: Your administrator account and recovery passphrase are set. Next, add the people who will use Alice on the Users page.

users.title: Users
users.resetPasswordText: The person is signed out everywhere and must use this password at the next sign-in. Give it to them in a safe way.

fields.name: Full name
fields.initialPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters. The person sets up their authenticator app at the first sign-in.

confirm.resetMfaText: The person is signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
confirm.revokeText: All open sessions of this person end now. They can sign in again.
confirm.disableText: The person is signed out and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
confirm.enableText: The person can sign in again with their password and authenticator app.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: API tokens let scripts and other tools use Alice on your behalf. A token never has more rights than your own role.
tokens.createdText: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeText: Scripts that use this token stop working immediately.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.broken: Audit log integrity problem at entry {{seq}}.
audit.brokenHelp: Someone may have changed or deleted entries. Keep a copy of the export and contact your security team.
audit.headHash: Fingerprint of the latest entry (write it down to detect later changes):

banner.evaluation_one: Evaluation mode: {{count}} day left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_other: Evaluation mode: {{count}} days left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_ended: The evaluation period has ended. Alice is now read-only for changes. Administrators can upload a license on the License page.
banner.expiry_warning_one: Your license expires in {{count}} day ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.expiry_warning_other: Your license expires in {{count}} days ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.grace: Your license expired on {{valid_until}}. Alice will stop automatic work on {{locks_at}} (168 hours after expiry). Contact your vendor now. Grace day {{grace_day}} of 7.
banner.locked: License expired. Automatic tasks are paused. Your data is safe and certificate expiry alerts still arrive by email. Administrators: upload a new license on the License page.
banner.tampered: License data was changed outside Alice, so Alice ignores the changed file. Upload the license file from your vendor again.
banner.clock_behind: The server clock changed unexpectedly (it says {{system_time}}, but Alice last saw {{last_seen}}). Alice is using the later date for license checks. Please correct the server time or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_one: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} day. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_other: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} days. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.pending: A new license ({{license_id}}) starts on {{valid_from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
banner.over_limit: You use {{used}} of {{max}} licensed targets. You cannot add more until you are within the limit.
banner.limit_reached: You are using all {{max}} licensed targets. To add more, ask your vendor to increase your license.
